newsitem.title: USA: Kellogg names Camstra as vice chairman.
newsitem.headline: Kellogg names Camstra as vice chairman.

text.p: Kellogg Co said it named executive vice president William Camstra, 64, as vice chairman, a position in which he will assist Kellogg Chairman Arnold Langbo.

Camstra, who has been with Kellogg 41 years, will give up his title as president of Kellogg Latin America, which he has held since 1992. He will be succeeded in that position by Alan Harris, who is currently executive vice president of marketing and sales for Kellogg USA's cereal division.

Kellogg also said Jonathan Wilson was promoted to executive vice president consumer and customer engagement for Kellogg USA, the cereal giant's U.S. operating unit. He will lead sales and marketing for all current Kellogg USA businesses. Wilson had served since 1994 as general manager of Kellogg USA's Convenience Foods Division.

A Kellogg spokesman said Camstra will assist in the transition of Harris into the Latin American position and will assist the Kellogg chairman's office, although he did not offer any further details. He declined to say whether Camstra was planning to retire soon.
